title: inula salicina subsp. aspera
intro: Inula salicina subsp. aspera, commonly known as Asperula salicina, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit cardioprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of Inula salicina subsp. aspera include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
